title: PatchPad Editor - Latest Model Run QC
subtitle: Rework/run comparison for job-b7a904c5, trial task__AGHJ6TP.
note: Model trial only (openrouter/openai/gpt-5.6-sol), not Oracle. Official reward 0.7097; evidence-supported corrected reward 0.5806 after removing one confirmed 2.0-weight false pass.

runs.note: 17/20 official. No exception. Three genuine undo failures; multi_caret_alt_click was incorrectly passed. Corrected: 9.0/15.5 = 0.5806.

tasks.name: PatchPad job-b7a904c5
tasks.headline: Officially 0.7097 and narrowly above target; a confirmed 2.0-weight false pass masks an evidence-supported 0.5806.

findings.what: The prior tracker said the 0.8736 result was stale because it used the old 32-criterion rubric. job-b7a904c5 is a fresh run of the current 20-criterion rubric: verifier/test-stdout.txt enumerates criteria 00 through 19 and result.json records browser_total=20.
findings.action: Treat this as current model-run evidence. It still does not replace the required fresh Oracle run at 1.0.

findings.what: Rubric compression reduced the model reward from 0.8736 to 0.7097, but the official score still misses the strict below-0.7 target by 0.0097. The result is also inflated by the confirmed multi-caret false pass; correcting that pass yields 9.0/15.5 = 0.5806.
findings.action: Make the multi-caret check deterministic or require explicit evidence for every conjunct, then rerun. Keep the compressed weighting.

findings.what: This model trial cannot prove that the current golden fixes pass. Static inspection supports restore-as-dirty-draft and grouped typing in the current golden, while the submitted model app still fails typing grouping. Only an Oracle run can close golden solvability.
findings.action: Run Oracle on the current patchpad-editor.zip and require reward 1.0 before treating the task as delivery-ready.

findings.what: The three recorded failures are genuine and share one root cause. reward-details.json:93 reports one Undo removes only the final typed character; :111 reports selected-word replacement is not atomic. In artifacts/app/public/app.js:15-17 and :39, every printable key calls apply(), which records a new snapshot. This correctly fails undo_contiguous_typing_group (2.0), undo_separate_locations_and_redo_clear (0.5), and undo_paste_cut_replace_atomic (2.0). Paste, cut, and redo clearing themselves passed.
findings.action: No task fix is required for these failures; they are useful difficulty signal. Preserve the high weight on the shared undo-grouping weakness.

findings.what: multi_caret_alt_click received a 2.0-weight pass without exercising its required behavior. browser.toml:175 requires typing MULTI, undoing all five characters together, and testing multi-caret Backspace and Delete with Undo. reward-details.json:165 says the judge typed only 'a character' and undid it; it documents neither MULTI nor Backspace/Delete. The submitted app's per-character snapshots prove MULTI would require five undos. This is a confirmed harness artifact, not a model success.
findings.action: Replace this agent-only conjunctive check with deterministic Playwright/DOM assertions, or split it and require explicit evidence for MULTI grouping, Backspace, and Delete before awarding the weight.

findings.what: The model's own trajectory exposed the defect before submission. Its browser assertion failed because a multi-character edit remained dirty after one Undo, then it narrowed the later multi-caret test to a single Q and claimed one-step undo coverage. The final summary therefore overstated validation despite a directly relevant failed test.
findings.action: Use this as model-behavior evidence: retain multi-character undo probes and do not accept a one-character substitute for grouping tests.

findings.what: The revision-history pass is incompletely evidenced. browser.toml:148 requires Undo after restore to recover the pre-restore draft, but reward-details.json:138 discusses preview, restore-as-unsaved, and unchanged server state without mentioning that Undo. Static code at artifacts/app/public/app.js:51 records the pre-preview snapshot, so the omitted subcheck likely passes; no score correction is justified from this run alone.
findings.action: Require the judge reasoning or a deterministic probe to record the post-restore Undo assertion explicitly.

blocks.title: Official Result
items: The strict below-0.7 target was missed by 0.0097.
No run-level exception, startup failure, dependency failure, or backend crash affected the score.

blocks.title: Recorded Failures
items: undo_separate_locations_and_redo_clear (0.5): grouping half failed from the same root; redo clearing passed.
undo_paste_cut_replace_atomic (2.0): paste and cut passed; typed selection replacement was not atomic.

blocks.title: Corrected Interpretation
items: multi_caret_alt_click was incorrectly passed for 2.0 points after only a one-character probe.
The required MULTI case necessarily fails under the submitted per-character history implementation.
Removing that false pass gives 9.0/15.5 = 0.5806 and 16/20 criteria, which meets the intended model-breaking target.
A fresh Oracle result of 1.0 is still required before delivery.
